content: {"reasoning":"The payer denied the service as noncovered under the plan, and the eligibility lapse supports that determination; the CPT/diagnosis pairing and COB order are already correct, while authorization was not required. Resubmission would not correct the coverage issue, and neither retro authorization nor peer-to-peer is available. With no secondary payer and PR-204 assigning responsibility to the patient, the balance should be billed to the patient rather than written off.","action":"bill_patient"}
